segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report reduced shine and less congestion in the T-zone, with one describing improvement in sebaceous filaments and enlarged pores.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry sensitive skin reports no dryness or irritation and no over-drying effect from the pads.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report smoother, more balanced texture, with tightening in oily zones and no irritation in drier areas.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers who identify as sensitive report no irritation, redness, or stinging, describing the pads as gentle; one non-sensitive reviewer nonetheless reports months of breakouts.
segments.mature: A 65-year-old reviewer with dry sensitive skin and a 50+ reviewer both report no irritation and visible brightening without dryness.

concerns.aging: Reviewers over 50 report brighter, smoother, more even-toned skin and a general antiaging refresh; no reviewer reports fine lines specifically worsening or improving.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the pads leave skin smooth and hydrated rather than dry, though one long-term user reports no real difference in her skin.
concerns.redness: Sensitive-skin reviewers repeatedly report no redness or stinging after use; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the pads as non-stripping and non-irritating even with frequent use, though one reviewer reports broken-out skin for months until discontinuing use.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fading of dark spots, acne scars, and hyperpigmentation with continued use; results are described as gradual over weeks.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report fewer breakouts, clearer skin, or help with body/back acne; one reviewer reports breaking out for months and one mentions occasional small breakouts alongside improvement.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report reduced shine, smaller-looking pores, and less visible sebaceous filaments in the T-zone; no reviewer with oily skin reports increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Pad discolors or yellows over time
Bulky, oversized packaging for product amount
High price, best bought on sale
Convenient for travel and quick routines
